# Task
Resolve the following GitHub issue in this repository by editing the source code. Do not modify or add tests.

<issue>
RegexTokenizer: Default token arguments are not mapped to vocabulary index
The ID's of the default special tokens in RegexTokenizer  are set here:

https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo/blob/72d78d832c6332ccc7f44811fb777eb7044df1d8/nemo/collections/common/tokenizers/regex_tokenizer.py#L75-L82

However, the constructor, allows custom special tokens:

https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo/blob/72d78d832c6332ccc7f44811fb777eb7044df1d8/nemo/collections/common/tokenizers/regex_tokenizer.py#L42-L51


So this could cause issues (specifically extra unknowns) when text is converted to tokens, then to ids, then back.
</issue>

37| class AggregateTokenizer(TokenizerSpec):
38|     '''
39|     AggregateTokenizer, allowing one to combine multiple regular monolongual tokenizers into one tokenizer.
40|     The intuition is that we can use existing tokenizers "as is", without retraining, and associate each tokenizer with a language id
41|     during text processing (language id will be used to route the incoming text sample to the right tokenizer)
42|     as well as a token id range for detokenization (e.g. [0..127] for tokenizer A, [128..255] for tokenizer B) so
43|     that the orignal text could be reconstructed. Note that we assume that the incoming dict of langs / tokenizers
44|     is ordered, e.g. the first tokenizer will be assigned a lower interval of token ids
45|         Args:
46|         tokenizers: dict of tokenizers, keys are lang ids, values are actual tokenizers
47|     '''
48| 
49|     def __init__(self, tokenizers: Dict):
50| 
51|         self.tokenizers_dict = tokenizers
52|         self.vocabulary = []
53| 
54|         # the tokenizers should produce non-overlapping, ordered token ids
55|         # keys are language ids
56|         self.token_id_offset = {}
57| 
58|         # keys are tokenizer numbers
59|         self.token_id_offset_by_tokenizer_num = {}
60|         offset = 0
61|         i = 0
62|         for lang, tokenizer in self.tokenizers_dict.items():
63|             self.token_id_offset[lang] = offset
64|             self.token_id_offset_by_tokenizer_num[i] = offset
65|             offset += len(tokenizer.vocab)
66|             i += 1
67| 
68|         for tokenizer in self.tokenizers_dict.values():
69|             self.vocabulary.extend(tokenizer.vocab)
70| 
71|         self.vocab_size = len(self.vocabulary)

78|         # lookup tables to speed up token to text operations
79|         # if there are two tokenizers, [0,1] each with 128 tokens, the aggregate tokenizer
80|         # token range will be [0,255]. The below method provides two look up tables:
81|         # one, to convert the incoming token id -- e.g. 200 into its real id (200-127 = 73)
82|         # and to compute the tokenizer id that should process that token (1)
83|         offset_token_ids_by_token_id, tokenizers_by_token_id = self._calculate_offsets()

93|         for id in range(len(self.vocabulary)):

95|             if cur_num + 1 < tot:
96|                 if id >= list(self.token_id_offset.values())[cur_num + 1]:
97|                     cur_num += 1
98|                     off_id = id - list(self.token_id_offset.values())[cur_num]
99|             offsets[id] = off_id
100|             tokenizers[id] = list(self.tokenizers_dict.values())[cur_num]

115|             # Remove end token and the following values
116|             if self.eos_token in token:
117|                 eos_idx = token.index(self.eos_token)
118|                 token = token[:eos_idx]
119| 
120|             tokens_list.append(token)
121| 
122|         text = ["".join(tokens) for tokens in tokens_list]

146|             added_list = False

148|         tokens_list = []
149|         for ids in ids_list:

153|                 if token is None:

155|                 tokens.append(token)
156| 
157|             tokens_list.append(tokens)

159|         if added_list:

162|             return tokens_list

202|         if not regex_file:
203|             raise ValueError(f"regex_file must be specified")
204| 
205|         vocab_file = vocab_file or self.vocab_file
206|         # try to infer vocab_file from regex_file
207|         if not vocab_file:
208|             vocab_file = os.path.splitext(regex_file)[0] + '.vocab'

210|         self.regex_file = regex_file

234| 
235|         # load vocab file

237|         # of characters separated by \n (None/"" for empty vocab)

239|         logging.info(f"Loading vocabulary from file = {vocab_file}")
240|         if os.path.exists(vocab_file):

29| class SentencePieceTokenizer(TokenizerSpec):
30|     '''
31|     Sentencepiecetokenizer https://github.com/google/sentencepiece.
32|         Args:
33|         model_path: path to sentence piece tokenizer model. To create the model use create_spt_model()
34|         special_tokens: either list of special tokens or dictionary of token name to token value
35|         legacy: when set to True, the previous behavior of the SentecePiece wrapper will be restored, 
36|             including the possibility to add special tokens inside wrapper.
37|     '''
38| 
39|     def __init__(
40|         self, model_path: str, special_tokens: Optional[Union[Dict[str, str], List[str]]] = None, legacy: bool = False
41|     ):
42|         if not model_path or not os.path.exists(model_path):
43|             raise ValueError(f"model_path: {model_path} is invalid")
44|         self.tokenizer = sentencepiece.SentencePieceProcessor()
45|         self.tokenizer.Load(model_path)
46| 
47|         self.original_vocab_size = self.tokenizer.get_piece_size()
48|         self.vocab_size = self.tokenizer.get_piece_size()
49|         self.legacy = legacy
50|         self.special_token_to_id = {}
51|         self.id_to_special_token = {}
52|         if special_tokens:
53|             if not self.legacy:
54|                 raise ValueError(
55|                     "Special tokens must be None when legacy is set to False. Provide special tokens at train time."
56|                 )
57|             self.add_special_tokens(special_tokens)
58| 
59|     def text_to_tokens(self, text):
60|         if self.legacy:
61|             tokens = []
62|             idx = 0
63|             last_idx = 0
64| 
65|             while 1:
66|                 indices = {}
67| 
68|                 for token in self.special_token_to_id:
69|                     try:
70|                         indices[token] = text[idx:].index(token)
71|                     except ValueError:
72|                         continue
73| 
74|                 if len(indices) == 0:
75|                     break
76| 
77|                 next_token = min(indices, key=indices.get)
78|                 next_idx = idx + indices[next_token]
79| 
80|                 tokens.extend(self.tokenizer.encode_as_pieces(text[idx:next_idx]))
81|                 tokens.append(next_token)
82|                 idx = next_idx + len(next_token)
83| 
84|             tokens.extend(self.tokenizer.encode_as_pieces(text[idx:]))
85|             return tokens
86| 
87|         return self.tokenizer.encode_as_pieces(text)
88| 
89|     def text_to_ids(self, text):
90|         if self.legacy:
91|             ids = []
92|             idx = 0
93|             last_idx = 0
94| 
95|             while 1:
96|                 indices = {}
97| 
98|                 for token in self.special_token_to_id:
99|                     try:
100|                         indices[token] = text[idx:].index(token)
101|                     except ValueError:
102|                         continue
103| 
104|                 if len(indices) == 0:
105|                     break
106| 
107|                 next_token = min(indices, key=indices.get)
108|                 next_idx = idx + indices[next_token]
109| 
110|                 ids.extend(self.tokenizer.encode_as_ids(text[idx:next_idx]))
111|                 ids.append(self.special_token_to_id[next_token])
112|                 idx = next_idx + len(next_token)
113| 
114|             ids.extend(self.tokenizer.encode_as_ids(text[idx:]))
115|             return ids
116| 
117|         return self.tokenizer.encode_as_ids(text)
118| 
119|     def tokens_to_text(self, tokens):
120|         if isinstance(tokens, np.ndarray):
121|             tokens = tokens.tolist()
122| 
123|         return self.tokenizer.decode_pieces(tokens)
124| 
125|     def ids_to_text(self, ids):
126|         if isinstance(ids, np.ndarray):
127|             ids = ids.tolist()
128| 
129|         if self.legacy:
130|             text = ""
131|             last_i = 0
132| 
133|             for i, id in enumerate(ids):
134|                 if id in self.id_to_special_token:
135|                     text += self.tokenizer.decode_ids(ids[last_i:i]) + " "
136|                     text += self.id_to_special_token[id] + " "
137|                     last_i = i + 1
138| 
139|             text += self.tokenizer.decode_ids(ids[last_i:])
140|             return text.strip()
141| 
142|         return self.tokenizer.decode_ids(ids)
143| 
144|     def token_to_id(self, token):
145|         if self.legacy and token in self.special_token_to_id:
146|             return self.special_token_to_id[token]
147| 
148|         return self.tokenizer.piece_to_id(token)
149| 
150|     def ids_to_tokens(self, ids):
151|         tokens = []
152|         for id in ids:
153|             if id >= self.original_vocab_size:
154|                 tokens.append(self.id_to_special_token[id])
155|             else:
156|                 tokens.append(self.tokenizer.id_to_piece(id))
157|         return tokens
158| 
159|     def tokens_to_ids(self, tokens: Union[str, List[str]]) -> Union[int, List[int]]:
160|         if isinstance(tokens, str):
161|             tokens = [tokens]
162|         ids = []
163|         for token in tokens:
164|             ids.append(self.token_to_id(token))
165|         return ids
166| 
167|     def add_special_tokens(self, special_tokens):
168|         if not self.legacy:
169|             raise AttributeError("Special Token addition does not work when legacy is set to False.")
170| 
171|         if isinstance(special_tokens, list):
172|             for token in special_tokens:
173|                 if (
174|                     self.tokenizer.piece_to_id(token) == self.tokenizer.unk_id()
175|                     and token not in self.special_token_to_id
176|                 ):
177|                     self.special_token_to_id[token] = self.vocab_size
178|                     self.id_to_special_token[self.vocab_size] = token
179|                     self.vocab_size += 1
180|         elif isinstance(special_tokens, dict):
181|             for token_name, token in special_tokens.items():
182|                 setattr(self, token_name, token)
183|                 if (
184|                     self.tokenizer.piece_to_id(token) == self.tokenizer.unk_id()
185|                     and token not in self.special_token_to_id
186|                 ):
187|                     self.special_token_to_id[token] = self.vocab_size
188|                     self.id_to_special_token[self.vocab_size] = token
189|                     self.vocab_size += 1
190| 
191|     @property
192|     def pad_id(self):
193|         if self.legacy:
194|             pad_id = self.tokens_to_ids([self.pad_token])[0]
195|         else:
196|             pad_id = self.tokenizer.pad_id()
197|         return pad_id
198| 
199|     @property
200|     def bos_id(self):
201|         if self.legacy:
202|             bos_id = self.tokens_to_ids([self.bos_token])[0]
203|         else:
204|             bos_id = self.tokenizer.bos_id()
205|         return bos_id
206| 
207|     @property
208|     def eos_id(self):
209|         if self.legacy:
210|             eos_id = self.tokens_to_ids([self.eos_token])[0]
211|         else:
212|             eos_id = self.tokenizer.eos_id()
213|         return eos_id
214| 
215|     @property
216|     def sep_id(self):
217|         if self.legacy:
218|             return self.tokens_to_ids([self.sep_token])[0]
219|         else:
220|             raise NameError("Use function token_to_id to retrieve special tokens other than unk, pad, bos, and eos.")
221| 
222|     @property
223|     def cls_id(self):
224|         if self.legacy:
225|             return self.tokens_to_ids([self.cls_token])[0]
226|         else:
227|             raise NameError("Use function token_to_id to retrieve special tokens other than unk, pad, bos, and eos.")
228| 
229|     @property
230|     def mask_id(self):
231|         if self.legacy:
232|             return self.tokens_to_ids([self.mask_token])[0]
233|         else:
234|             raise NameError("Use function token_to_id to retrieve special tokens other than unk, pad, bos, and eos.")
235| 
236|     @property
237|     def unk_id(self):
238|         return self.tokenizer.unk_id()
239| 
240|     @property
241|     def additional_special_tokens_ids(self):
242|         """Returns a list of the additional special tokens (excluding bos, eos, pad, unk). Used to return sentinel tokens for e.g. T5."""
243|         special_tokens = set(
244|             [self.bos_token, self.eos_token, self.pad_token, self.mask_token, self.cls_token, self.sep_token]
245|         )
246|         return [v for k, v in self.special_token_to_id.items() if k not in special_tokens]
247| 
248|     @property
249|     def vocab(self):
250|         main_vocab = [self.tokenizer.id_to_piece(id) for id in range(self.tokenizer.get_piece_size())]
251|         special_tokens = [
252|             self.id_to_special_token[self.original_vocab_size + i]
253|             for i in range(self.vocab_size - self.original_vocab_size)
254|         ]
255|         return main_vocab + special_tokens
